title: Localization of the explicit ordinary scalar source compositor
statement: For the ordinary source functors and consecutive compositor of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-ordinary-scalar-model], exact localization agrees with the prescribed derived source compositor, via the explicit factorizations of the composite ordinary source into its five exact factors. This equality is independent of any source-target comparison, tower, completed target model, or perfectness.

source.place: Tags 093J, 093M and 03CY; Cohomology on Sites Tag 06YY; Derived Categories Tag 05RU.

proof.text: Prove a generic pasting identity for exact localization: naturality of the tail factorization, composition associativity, and compatibility of localization with left and right whiskering transport an inner square through one more exact functor.

The scalar coherence is the localization of the ordinary associated-module comparison. Apply the generic identity successively to pro-etale inverse image, comparison inverse image, constant sheafification and coefficient universe transport. Expand the specified derived comparisons and cancel the associator identities. This gives the exact source factorization equation.
